lookahead.note: Synthetic CI fixture: 30ms causal context + 40ms controlled lookahead, far below the legacy direction classifier's 120ms post-onset window.

splitStrategy.leakageCheckMethod: Synthetic CI fixture: asserted disjoint guitarist-id sets between train and test masks.

definition.text: Precision/recall/F1 of peak-picked joint-model onset events against expected onset events, matched within an inclusive 50ms tolerance, ignoring predicted direction.
Macro-averaged per-direction (down/up) F1 over time-matched onset pairs; a strum missed or falsely detected in time still counts as a false negative/positive for its own class.
Algorithmic verdict latency: preFrames*hopMs context plus lookaheadFrames*hopMs lookahead the model must observe before it can commit to a verdict. Not a real-time on-device measurement.
Legacy two-stage pipeline's SuperFlux onset detector F1 at 50ms tolerance, anchored from the merged baseline manifest (ADR 0354), same corpus.

legacyDirectionF1UpperBound.derivation: The legacy end-to-end direction macro-F1 is not measured on this corpus (baseline_manifest.json metricBlocks.direction.status = not-measured). A correct end-to-end direction call requires a correctly time-matched onset first, so end-to-end direction macro-F1 cannot exceed onset F1 @50ms — this row restates that onset F1 as an explicit ceiling, not a direction measurement.

definition.text: Upper bound on the legacy pipeline's end-to-end direction macro-F1, derived from its onset F1 @50ms via the onset-precedes-direction inequality. Never a measured direction number.

verdict.rationale: Synthetic CI fixture: both prototype metrics are below the Chapter 14 Strum Alpha gate, so the verdict is no-go.
